# Tikauddesa (Pp 1.3)

**ID:** Pp 1.3
**Section:** Puggalapaññatti (pp)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Tikauddesa
**SuttaCentral:** https://suttacentral.net/pp1.3
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh03m2.mul0.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Tikauddesa* is the third section of the opening schedule or matrix (*mātikā-uddesa*) of the *Puggalapaññatti*, a treatise in the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral; Hirakawa 1990]. In the introductory framework of the *Puggalapaññatti*, the category of persons (*puggala*) is systematically subdivided into numerical groupings ranging from one to ten individuals [Hirakawa 1990]. The *Tikauddesa* presents the matrix of triads—classifications of persons grouped by threes—serving as the index for the detailed expositions found later in the *Tikapuggalapaññatti* (Pp 2.3) [Hirakawa 1990; DharmaNexus].

SuttaCentral records one translation in one language but lists no curated parallels for the text [SuttaCentral]. Text-reuse analysis conducted by DharmaNexus reveals substantial Pali-internal correspondence across seven texts (112 matches), predominantly with the *Tikanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (45 matches, 4,085 characters) and the subsequent explanatory chapter *Tikapuggalapaññatti* (Pp 2.3; 27 matches, 2,330 characters) [DharmaNexus]. Shared passages are also identified with the commentary *Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*, the post-canonical *Saṅgāyana-puccha vissajjanā*, the *Navakanipāta* (AN 9), the *Aṅguttaranikāye Dukanipāta-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Catukkanipāta* (AN 4) [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches with a score of 10 or higher were identified in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora [DharmaNexus].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Tikanipāta (AN 3) (§14.1_0–16.1 ↔ §26.1.3–26.2.2); Tikapuggalapaññatti (Pp 2.3) (§15.1–16.1 ↔ §43.1–44.2); Saṅgāyana-puccha vissajjanā Suttantapiṭaka Aṅguttaranikāye (Anya E0904n) (§14.1_0–15.2 ↔ §346_3–348_1); Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Abh03a) (§15.1 ↔ §321_0–321_1); Navakanipāta (AN 9) (§16.1 ↔ §12.7.1); Aṅguttaranikāye Dukanipāta-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0402a) (§15.1 ↔ §437_11); Catukkanipāta (AN 4) (§16.1–16.3 ↔ §136.1.3–136.3.1)
